terms.comment: Our working “API key.” clāvis, clāvis f. — key. Retain the technical abbreviation API when its exact identity matters. These descriptions supplement the email-platform discussion; they are not recovered quotations from an older vocabulary list.

phrases.latin: Hāc clāve numerōs legere mihi licet.
phrases.english: This key lets me read the figures.

phrases.latin: Hāc clāve data mūtāre mihi nōn licet.
phrases.english: This key does not let me change the data.

sources: Lewis & Short: clavis · Lewis & Short: lego. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
